folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: ascension receipt scope, 2026-11-04 (B354)
folds.body:
The leaf contract, typed crossings and knowledge-limited path view are distinct from the LOTM acting/dose/promotion implementation. A ladder row is not proof that its ability, forcing route, ritual or native use exists. Retain the narrow 17-test and 2,547-test receipts, rebuilt 1920×1080 route and literal import observations as dated evidence on the recorded inputs. The export-function call did not exercise the native download button, and missing smaller-desktop/large-text cases remain outside that receipt. Human taste review is optional under AD42.

The schema-1 label did not make forward compatibility automatic: the new source/item keys and validators were the relevant boundary. The old developer-only query and disposable-fixture rationale describe that delivery’s entry policy; localhost or a query flag alone does not make a current app/save intrinsically isolated. Recheck the selected actual entry/admission boundary before carrying that assumption into ordinary play. No new persistence permission is granted by this report.

The source list distinguishes official/store text, press reporting and guide-only claims; it does not establish a newly verified current game, all pathway rules or primary-novel canon. Existing qualification and source owners govern any later lore claim. Current LOTM/Klein and Harry priorities supersede old Mistglass reservations as global build-order evidence, while the old exact owner exclusions remain historical coordination. Ritual/forcing/ability gaps and ASC proposals are preserved without launching workers or requiring a universal ascension system. No fresh build, runtime, source, save or browser verification occurred here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: journey and estate receipt precedence, 2026-11-04 (B354)
folds.body:
Read this checkpoint chronologically through its final routing. The initial 2,726/2,727 icon failure and incomplete O4 harness are superseded by the recorded final fixes and bounded proof. The later estate-label correction likewise supersedes the earlier open-preview-defect wording: exact released source hunks and isolated rebuilt browser evidence were recorded, while adoption into the actual combined candidate remained a separate gate. Neither the older 2,727-test full pass nor an isolated bundle establishes a fresh final full pass after that text correction or its present integration status.

O1’s final GDP40 branch has its own rebuilt full-control refusal proof; earlier O1 evidence is reusable for unchanged relevant behavior, not byte-identical final inputs. O2 reused an existing journey without inventing a repair. O3 proves finite prepaid absence with real supplies and review controls, not general browser-closed routines or every journey-wide time-bank policy. O4’s accelerated age prerequisite is fixture setup; actual body/custody/return/heir and saved results are the claimed route. Estate plus the existing fresh-start purse is not estate alone. O5’s actual control-font/viewport checks remain specific to those captures and input identity.

Keep estate naming a projection: observer-facing native names and readable fallback must not expose unknown mixtures, allocate item condition, change inheritance keys or settle an estate by rendering. The same helper region’s kin changes belong to their actual owner; the historical release covered exact hunks and tests rather than general main/inheritance control. Patches, matching prior hashes and process IDs are dated receipts, not live writer releases or servers to manipulate now.

GDP41–GDP46 preserve useful heat/medium/precision, independent actor support, clocks and transition ideas. Saved future proposals are not dispatched gameplay. Current source/candidate evidence determines adoption; this review does not repeat patch application, query old chats, create workers, operate servers or run gameplay checks. Human review remains optional, mobile remains deferred, and no installation/publication/commit/push is claimed.
